key_decisions.decision: Pinned dwelling and commanded, not harmonized Psalm31.
Keep hands and violence, difficult ruthless term.
Both divine names retained without collapsing title.
Gozi birth assistance rendering with uncertainty noted.
Portent may be ominous, not automatically positive example.
